problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:

* Package 1: size 31 units
* Package 2: size 67 units
* Package 3: size 62 units
* Package 4: size 51 units
* Package 5: size 68 units
* Package 6: size 36 units
* Package 7: size 66 units
* Package 8: size 45 units
* Package 9: size 31 units
* Package 10: size 32 units
* Package 11: size 36 units
* Package 12: size 49 units
* Package 13: size 35 units
* Package 14: size 67 units
* Package 15: size 55 units
* Package 16: size 38 units
* Package 17: size 66 units
* Package 18: size 69 units
* Package 19: size 63 units
* Package 20: size 42 units
* Package 21: size 47 units
* Package 22: size 48 units
* Package 23: size 40 units
* Package 24: size 41 units
* Package 25: size 67 units
* Package 26: size 44 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
